subject: Re: Kickoff: invariant explanations / meta-model audits
body: Decision from Monday's review: the audit-tool prototype is a go, X,H covariates only. Rationale: X,H at train_fraction 0.8 delivers 87.9% with trivial storage, while W@epoch adds under a point at the epochs worth using but drags the 2 TB snapshot problem into every customer conversation — so W@epoch is cut from the product path and stays a research question. Q3 scope (locked in OKRs before June 26): prototype serving one pilot vision team, meta-model retrained weekly, audit report rendered through Evalline. Vera owns productionizing the covariate-pipeline handoff from Bilal as he rolls off; Fumiko's calibration section made the LRB pre-read and Nadia flagged no blockers. Nice work — this went from paper mechanics to a fundable tool in a quarter. — Lucia
